scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run site -w server -- push hello ../examples/hello "Hello, Bigglenet" && npm run site -w server -- push home ../sites/home "The Bigglenet homepage"
scripts.check: npm run check -w server && npm run check -w browser
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w browser && npm run deploy -w server
scripts.app:build: npm run build -w browser && npm run dist -w desktop
scripts.deploy:home: npm run site -w server -- push home ../sites/home "The Bigglenet homepage" --owner ethem_ --remote
scripts.deploy:games: npm run site -w server -- push games ../sites/games "Games" --owner ethem_ --remote
scripts.deploy:hello: npm run site -w server -- push hello ../examples/hello "Hello, Bigglenet" --owner ethem_ --remote
